versions.subject: Merge pull request #4294 from @danielbohannon - Permiso p0-LUCR-1 (aka GUI-vil)
versions.detection:
selection:
    eventSource: iam.amazonaws.com
    eventName: PutUserPolicy
    userAgent|contains: 'S3 Browser'
    requestParameters|contains|all:
        - '"arn:aws:s3:::<YOUR-BUCKET-NAME>/*"'
        - '"s3:GetObject"'
        - '"Allow"'
condition: selection
versions.spl: eventSource="iam.amazonaws.com" eventName="PutUserPolicy" userAgent="*S3 Browser*" requestParameters="*\"arn:aws:s3:::<YOUR-BUCKET-NAME>/*\"*" requestParameters="*\"s3:GetObject\"*" requestParameters="*\"Allow\"*"
